title: Marta Matyjewicz - Recipe for Irresistible Game Marketing Campaigns
description:
Marta Matyjewicz - Recipe for Irresistible Game Marketing Campaigns

Are you non-stop chasing changes in online algorithms? Trying to hack game stores and social media platforms? Instead of always being three steps behind, listen to this talk and rebalance your game marketing strategy. … and learn how the power to forget things can actually save your marketing campaign.
